basics.name: Damien Dormal
basics.label: Staff Software Engineer
basics.summary: Staff Software Engineer with 15+ years of experience building and scaling distributed systems. Product-minded technical leader who bridges engineering, product, and business stakeholders. Proven track record as both IC and Engineering Manager. Proficient with AI-augmented engineering workflows. Deep expertise in card issuing platforms, IDV/KYC, and bank/network integrations.
